answer: Faking identities means locking real capital per account, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes, and any proven duplicate forfeits the bond to challengers. Sybil resistance can work like a trellis: every new agent must stake collateral at a single registration inlet, and only agents whose stake survives a random zephyr of peer challenges earn voting weight. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
